projects.title: Leading Policy Innovation
projects.description:
The Solvo Institute, focused on unlocking societal potential through research and policy change, sought our expertise to develop their brand identity and website. 

We crafted a cohesive design that aligns with their mission, helping them establish a strong online presence and position themselves as a leader in policy innovation.

Result

Following the launch of their brand identity and website design for the Solvo Institute, their online presence significantly improved, positioning them as a thought leader in policy innovation.
